title: fix: populate network settings in container inspect when network stat…
body:
When inspecting a container running in rootless mode with pasta networking (or any setup where c.getNetworkStatus() returns empty), getContainerNetworkInfo() would return early (if len(netStatus) == 0 { return settings, nil }).

Because of this early return, user-defined networks attached to the container were never populated into NetworkSettings.Networks. This caused compatibility endpoints (GET /containers/{id}/json) and CLI inspect to report empty or missing network configurations for user-defined networks.

Fixes: https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/29862
